paragraphs: Rabbi Chidka, a Tanna of the baraita: Kol Kitvei 117, end of side b; Taanit 11a, he said, “A person’s soul testifies ….” Shimon HaShikmoni, one of Rabbi Akiva’s students, was his colleague: Bava Batra 119a; Sifrei, Behaalotekha, passage “They performed the Passover offering”; Shelach; Pinchas.
